annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear directive for origin servers to send a Content-Length header field when the payload size is known before sending the complete header section, and only in the absence of Transfer-Encoding. The language is prescriptive (SHOULD) and does not allow for multiple materially different interpretations. There is no missing constraint that would affect implementation behavior.
